use proc_macro2::{Delimiter, Group, Ident, Literal, Punct, Spacing, Span, TokenStream, TokenTree};
fn main() {
    let parsed: TokenStream = "fn café<'a>(value: &'a str) -> Option<u32> { Some(17) }".parse().unwrap();
    println!("{}", parsed);
    let cloned = parsed.clone();
    assert_eq!(parsed.into_iter().count(), cloned.clone().into_iter().count());
    let mut built = TokenStream::new();
    built.extend([
        TokenTree::Ident(Ident::new("answer", Span::call_site())),
        TokenTree::Punct(Punct::new('=', Spacing::Alone)),
        TokenTree::Literal(Literal::u32_suffixed(37)),
        TokenTree::Punct(Punct::new(';', Spacing::Alone)),
    ]);
    let group = Group::new(Delimiter::Brace, built);
    println!("{}", group);
    println!("{} {} {}", Literal::string("a\n\"b"), Literal::character('🦀'), Literal::byte_string(b"\0\xff"));
    assert!("(unclosed".parse::<TokenStream>().is_err());
    assert!(TokenStream::new().is_empty());
}
